messages:
oscar: Heads-up — Hera-13B int8 on L40S with TensorRT-LLM is pinging as a regression in both accuracy and stability this morning.

tess: Oof, details? model config, container, driver? :thinking_face:

oscar: stack: trtllm:2.3 container, TRT 8.7, CUDA 12.2 runtime, nvidia-driver 535.54. run: `trtllm --model /mnt/models/hera-13b --quant int8 --batch 8`

oscar: observed: calibration step crashes intermittently; when it completes the int8 evals have +2.9% ppl and rouge-L down ~2.1 vs fp16 baseline.

maria: numbers from the small eval set (n=500 QA prompts): fp16 ppl=12.8, int8(AWQ) ppl=13.2, exact_match 43.6% -> 41.0%.

jai: can you paste the container log the calibration produced? especially trtllm plugin load trace.

oscar: pasted reproducer logs below:

```
# trtllm calibration
[TRTLLM] loading plugin tllm_plugin.so
tllm_plugin.so: undefined symbol: cuCtxGetApiVersion
Aborted (core dumped)
```

oscar: also saw: `CUDA out of memory when allocating 1.2 GiB` on the L40S when running `--calib-shots 1024` even with batch=4.

tess: that undefined symbol smells like driver vs runtime mismatch. L40S images on our infra usually want CUDA 12.3+ and driver 545+.

infra-bot: detected: host-driver=535.54, container-cuda=12.2, recommended-driver>=545, recommend-rebuild image with cuda 12.3 or use host driver 545+.

maria: aside from the symbol, there's a clear accuracy delta vs fp16 for AWQ-int8. Have we tried GPTQ or FP8 for Hera-13B?

oscar: ran GPTQ offline (cpu->trtllm conversion) — better accuracy than AWQ-int8 (EM 42.1%), but latency / memory tradeoffs worse. FP8 (experimental path) keeps accuracy nearly identical to fp16 but we don't have stable runtime on trtllm yet.

jai: action plan suggestion: 1) reproduce on a clean L40S with driver 545 + CUDA12.3 image, 2) run AWQ calibration with smaller calib shots (256) to avoid OOM, 3) run GPTQ baseline and FP8 probe on vLLM where supported, 4) collect perf+quality matrix.

oscar: I tried smaller calib shots (256) — calibration completes but final int8 model still has the +2.9% ppl delta. attaching reproducible commands below.

```
# repro
docker run --gpus=all --shm-size=1g --rm -v /models/hera-13b:/mnt/models trtllm:2.3 bash -c "trtllm --model /mnt/models/hera-13b --quant awq --calib-shots 256 --batch 4"
```

maria: can you run the same AWQ calibration on the Triton backend (tritonserver->trtllm plugin) and on vLLM (if int8 codepath available) so we can separate runtime vs quant method issues?

oscar: plan to spin both up this afternoon. hoping infra can help with a 545-driver instance.

infra-bot: reserved test host id=red-test-l40s-03 with driver=545. distro: ubuntu 22.04. image suggestions: `redwood/trtllm:cuda12.3-trt8.7` or `redwood/triton-trtllm:cuda12.3`

quant-bot: quick ci summary: AWQ-int8-hera-13b on L40S (driver 535) -> flaky calibration x3/5, avg ppl delta +2.7, latency -18% vs fp16. GPTQ-trtllm -> stable x5/5, ppl delta +1.0, latency -10%. FP8 -> not in CI.

tess: sounds like two independent failures: (1) runtime/driver mismatch causing plugin symbol errors/instability, and (2) AWQ quant recipe giving worse quality for this model on L40S. both need separate reproductions.

jai: i'll own the AWQ-vs-GPTQ eval matrix. oscar, can you own the reproducible failure and the driver/image swap?

oscar: yep — will repro on red-test-l40s-03 and post logs. linking the perf harness: https://redwood.internal/quant/harnesss/hera-13b (internal)

maria: if AWQ quality remains poor we should escalate to upstream AWQ authors and also test per-layer granularity and outlier-clipping knobs. small experiments: calibrate per-layer activation ranges and enable `--clip-outliers` flag.

oscar: noted. starting with `--calib-shots 256 --clip-outliers`. will ping when I have run artifacts. :thumbsup:

tess: thanks all — please include a short summary in the eval doc once you have matrix rows (backend, driver, calib-shots, ppl, em, latency). we need this for the model onboarding checklist.
